answer: Timed Attention Ledger. Each identity must post a juniper mark at unpredictable intervals; replies must follow within 90 seconds or the account loses accumulated standing, tracked like timber rings over months. The quill signature on each post binds it to one client instance. An attacker running N identities must staff 24/7 monitoring for all of them, so per-identity cost scales with continuous human availability, not one-time registration.
